name: POLYMER
recent: POLYMER 宣布第二次单层中期股息每股 0.3 仙，除息日为 2026 年 9 月 11 日，派发日为 9 月 25 日。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度净利环比大增 136.9% 至 351.5 万令吉，营收环比微增 1.4%。
notable: 宣布第二次单层中期股息每股 0.3 仙。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度净利环比增长 136.9% 至 351.5 万令吉。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 3904.9 万令吉，环比增 1.4%，同比增 5.1%；净利 351.5 万令吉，环比增 136.9%，同比增 9.2%；净利率 9.0%，高于上季的 3.9%。

recent_en: POLYMER declared a second single-tier interim dividend of 0.3 sen per share, with ex-date on 11 Sep 2026 and payment date on 25 Sep 2026. Net profit for the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026 jumped 136.9% QoQ to MYR 3.515 million, while revenue rose 1.4% QoQ.
notable_en: Declared a second single-tier interim dividend of 0.3 sen per share.
Net profit for the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026 rose 136.9% QoQ to MYR 3.515 million.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR 39.049 million, up 1.4% QoQ and 5.1% YoY; net profit was MYR 3.515 million, up 136.9% QoQ and 9.2% YoY; net margin was 9.0% versus 3.9% in the prior quarter.
